title: Phone-access wording
responsibility: Format connection, identity, permission and lock-state wording for phone access.

inputs.name: relayName.origin
inputs.description: An absolute relay URL whose authority supplies the displayed host and optional port. Null or an invalid URL produces an empty string.

inputs.name: hostLine.status
inputs.description: The public phone-access status for this computer. The line uses the relay host and adds a suffix only for registering, connecting, or offline states.

inputs.name: hostSummary.status
inputs.description: The public phone-access status for this computer. Disabled access is reported directly; otherwise the summary counts its devices, including zero as no phone.

inputs.name: timeLeft.milliseconds
inputs.description: Milliseconds remaining for an offer. The value is rounded up to whole seconds and clamped at zero, with no upper limit.

inputs.name: grantSummary.grant
inputs.description: A grant with the projects to count and the agents permission flag. Project entries are not inspected, and this input type does not include a comments flag.

inputs.name: remoteLabels.status
inputs.description: The phone’s reported status for its computer. Its state selects the wording; a missing or empty host name falls back to your computer, and lock wording is shown only for a boolean locked value.

inputs.name: identityLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: A device identity string, documented as the hash of its key. The helper groups it in consecutive groups of up to four characters without truncating it.

inputs.name: plural.count
inputs.description: The number printed before the word. Only the numeric value 1 keeps the word singular; every other number gets an appended s.

inputs.name: plural.word
inputs.description: The singular word printed after the count. The helper appends s unless the count is exactly 1.

inputs.name: keyLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: A device identity string, documented as the hash of its key. Only its first 12 characters are grouped in up to three groups of four; shorter inputs remain shorter.

inputs.name: grantLabel.grant
inputs.description: A grant whose agents flag and optional comments flag select the permission wording. When comments is omitted, agents alone selects the legacy wording.

outputs.name: lockNote
outputs.description: Fixed guidance that approved phones work while the computer is locked and awake, and that a sleeping computer is offline.
examples: Approved phones keep working while this Mac is locked and awake. A sleeping Mac is offline.

outputs.name: awakeNote
outputs.description: Fixed wording used when the computer’s lock state was not reported.
examples: Computer awake · works while its screen is locked

outputs.name: lockedNote
outputs.description: Fixed wording used when the computer reported that it is locked and awake.

outputs.name: unlockedNote
outputs.description: Fixed wording used when the computer reported that it is unlocked and awake.

outputs.name: approveNote
outputs.description: Fixed instruction shown while a phone awaits approval on the computer.
examples: Approve this phone in Harness on your computer.

outputs.name: awayNote
outputs.description: Fixed explanation used when an offline status has no reason text.
examples: It is asleep or has no network. Nothing is sent until it is back.

outputs.name: revokedNote
outputs.description: Fixed instruction shown after the computer removes the phone’s access.
examples: Pair again from your computer to continue.

outputs.name: relayName
outputs.description: The URL host and optional port, without scheme, path, or query; invalid or null input yields an empty string.

outputs.name: timeLeft
outputs.description: Remaining time formatted as unbounded whole minutes, a colon, and two-digit seconds after rounding milliseconds up and clamping at zero.

outputs.name: keyLabel
outputs.description: The first 12 characters of a device identity, grouped in fours; characters after the first 12 are omitted.

outputs.name: identityLabel
outputs.description: The full device identity grouped in consecutive groups of up to four characters, retaining the final partial group.

outputs.name: grantLabel
outputs.description: Permission wording selected from agents and comments: omitted comments uses the legacy labels; explicit comments distinguishes read-only, commenting, and agent-write access.
examples: Write · read, comment and ask AI

outputs.name: grantSummary
outputs.description: The project count followed by grant permission wording. The count uses the generic plural helper, and the grant input’s agents flag selects the legacy permission label.

outputs.name: hostLine
outputs.description: A phone-access-on line containing the relay host and, for registering, connecting, or offline states, the corresponding fixed suffix.
examples: Phone access is on · relay.example:8443 · registering…
Phone access is on · relay.example:8443 · relay unreachable

outputs.name: hostSummary
outputs.description: Disabled access returns Phone access off. Enabled access reports the device count as phones, or no phone when the list is empty.

outputs.name: remoteLabels
outputs.description: A title and detail selected by the phone status state. Host-specific wording uses the reported host name or your computer, and online lock wording appears only when lock state is known.

examples.title: Computer offline
examples.detail: It is asleep or has no network. Nothing is sent until it is back.

examples.title: This phone’s access was removed on the computer.
examples.detail: Pair again from your computer to continue.
